## Objective
- Improve the existing playable game: add usable mobile controls, more believable bots and an open-world battlefield, and detailed weapon models with reload animation.
- Continue refining the T-34-85 interaction and make faction selection playable for Germany.

## Requirements
- Add an on-screen joystick for walking and a nearby vehicle-entry control when close to transport.
- Make the game’s look more cartoonish and fun.
- Bots should use varied routes and tactics, notice and engage each other, and enter/use transport rather than marching in straight lines.
- Add proper weapon models instead of a stick, plus a reload animation.
- Expand the map into a compact open world; avoid the long, empty-plate feeling.
- User has not yet tested the updated game as Germany.

## Decisions
- The previous response interpreted the initial walking issue as broken movement controls and added keyboard, touch joystick movement, and touch-swipe look.
- A detailed T-34-85 model and basic drivable interaction were added in `three-game.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- `three-game.js`: added T-34-85 geometry and basic driving interaction; movement accepts WASD and arrow keys.
- `three-game.js`: added touch-swipe camera look; `node --check three-game.js` passed.

### Active
- Implement mobile vehicle-entry control that appears near the vehicle.
- Improve visual style, bots’ movement/target selection and ally/enemy interactions, map layout, weapons, and reload animation.

- Продолжить улучшение игры: сделать удобные мобильные джойстики движения и прицеливания/поворота, отдельную стрельбу и заметно более объёмную, реалистичную модель оружия.

- Мобильное управление должно включать джойстик ходьбы, джойстик прицеливания и отдельную кнопку стрельбы.

- Сохранить и продолжать существующие улучшения игры и управления.

- Движение и прицеливание разделены на два сенсорных джойстика; стрельба вынесена в отдельную кнопку.

### Completed

- Продолжить улучшение игры: удобное мобильное управление и детализированная объёмная модель оружия, соответствующая качеству модели Т-34-85.

- На мобильных устройствах нужны отдельные джойстики движения и прицеливания, а также отдельная кнопка стрельбы.

- Движение и прицеливание управляются отдельными сенсорными джойстиками; стрельба вынесена в отдельную кнопку.

- Кнопка FIRE стреляет при удержании с интервалом; движение и сенсорный ввод камеры разделены.

## Objective
- Improve the game with separate mobile movement and aiming controls plus a dedicated fire button.
- Replace the basic weapon model with detailed faction-specific 3D weapons while preserving gameplay improvements.

## Requirements
- Mobile controls must support separate MOVE and AIM joysticks, FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Weapon appearance should match the selected faction.

## Decisions
- Use a PPSh-41 with drum magazine for the USSR and an MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock for Germany.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added separate mobile stick handlers, aiming limits, sustained fire while FIRE is held, and RELOAD handling.
- Added detailed faction-specific PPSh-41 and MP 40 meshes in `makeWeapon()`.
- Fixed mobile controls not appearing: inserted whitespace before the `@media(max-width:720px)` rule in `index.html`.
- Verified a 390×844 mobile viewport shows MOVE, AIM, FIRE, RELOAD, and jump controls; `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the CSS fix.

### Active
- Validate mobile simultaneous touch input, firing/reloading, and actual weapon appearance for both factions. Automated browser testing showed the USSR label; the attempted Germany switch still showed PPSh-41, so Germany is not yet verified.
- Rerun syntax and diff checks after the latest CSS change.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Continue browser-checking the gameplay and weapon meshes for both factions; resolve why the attempted faction switch still displayed PPSh-41.
2. Validate mobile joystick/fire/reload interactions and control placement.
3. Rerun `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and CSS, including the mobile media query fix.
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input handlers, firing/reload behavior, faction selection, and `makeWeapon()`.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- Headless mobile testing reported `WrongDocumentError: The root document of this element is not valid for pointer lock.` during simulated interaction; assess whether this is only a headless test artifact.

## Objective
- Improve the game with separate mobile movement and aiming controls plus a dedicated fire button.
- Add detailed faction-specific 3D weapons and ensure deployment uses the selected faction’s weapon.

## Requirements
- Mobile controls must support separate MOVE and AIM joysticks, FIRE, RELOAD, and vehicle interaction.
- Weapon appearance should match the selected faction.

## Decisions
- Use a PPSh-41 with drum magazine for the USSR and an MP 40 with box magazine and folding stock for Germany.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added separate mobile stick handlers, aiming limits, sustained fire while FIRE is held, and RELOAD handling.
- Added detailed faction-specific PPSh-41 and MP 40 meshes in `makeWeapon()`.
- Fixed the mobile media query in `index.html`; browser testing at 390×844 confirmed mobile controls display with visible bounds.

### Active
- Diagnose why selecting Germany still appears to leave the HUD weapon as PPSh-41; a latest test script was changed to select Germany from a clean flow, but its output did not establish the result.
- Validate simultaneous mobile touch input and firing/reloading; current browser run did not test these interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the updated `/tmp/opencode/check.mjs` and verify the selected faction and weapon after deployment; inspect faction state and `makeWeapon()` deployment logic if mismatch persists.
2. Test simultaneous MOVE/AIM/FIRE/RELOAD touch interactions and control placement.
3. Run `node --check three-game.js` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Mobile HUD markup and CSS, including the corrected media query.
- `three-game.js`: Mobile input handlers, faction selection, weapon construction, and deployment.
- `/tmp/opencode/check.mjs`: Browser test script updated to exercise clean Germany selection and deployment.

## Important Context
- Changes to `index.html` and `three-game.js` are uncommitted.
- Headless browser testing reports `WrongDocumentError: The root document of this element is not valid for pointer lock.` during deployment; likely test-environment related, but assess if needed.
- The latest browser run’s output was truncated and did not verify whether Germany deploys with the MP 40.
